items.title: Interlocking Celtic Circle Lattice Vector File for Decorative CNC Panels
items.description: A complex, structural geometric panel design showcasing a continuous lattice of interlocking circles and Celtic knot aesthetics. This heavy-duty vector pattern is delivered in clean DXF, SVG, and DWG cutting formats, mathematically balanced to guarantee flawless execution on CNC routers, waterjet, and fiber laser machines. Perfect for manufacturing premium security window screens, cabinet doors, and ornamental partitions.
